author: Reel FX Animation
title: Reel FX hiring matte painting artists
content: Let your talent run wild! Reel FX Animation is looking for Matte Painting Artists to work on wonderful environments for our 3D feature Doctor Dolittle: King of the Wild. Tools: Maya, Nuke, Photoshop, After Effects. Location: Montréal, 3 days/week in studio. Start date: ASAP. Apply today and show your portfolio: https://careers.reelfx.com/apply/823?language=en

author: Asymptote Journal
title: Asymptote seeking guest illustrators
content: Asymptote is seeking designers and guest artists! We are looking for imaginative designers to join our international team, as well as guest artists interested in shaping the look and atmosphere of a single issue. We are also inviting illustrators to collaborate with us on a single quarterly issue, working alongside our editorial team. Interested? Attach a cover letter to your portfolio and send an application to editors@asymptotejournal.com.
